Company.label: Lao Tax ID (ເລກປະຈຳຕົວ)
Company.description: Lao Revenue Department Tax Identification Number (TIN)
Company._why: Distinct from ERPNext's own tax_id, which tenants use for other jurisdictions. Sits immediately after it so the two read as a pair.

Company.label: Business Registration No. (ທະບີນວິສາຫະກິດ)
Not VAT Registered — Micro-enterprise (ບໍ່ໄດ້ຈົດທະບຽນ VAT)
Company.description: Tick for a micro-enterprise below the VAT registration threshold. Suppresses the VAT checks on invoices for this company.
Company._why: Micro-enterprises are excluded from automatic VAT registration and pay a flat 5% CIT on net profit under Law No. 88/NA. They are 94.2% of Lao enterprises by count, so every VAT prompt in this app is wrong for them.

Company.label: Profit Tax Regime (ລະບອບອາກອນກຳໄລ)
Company.description: Standard = 20% on net profit. Micro-enterprise = 5% on net profit under Law on Income Tax No. 88/NA. Set by your accountant — this app does not test the qualification.
Company._why: Separate from lao_not_vat_registered on purpose. VAT registration and profit tax regime are different facts with different consequences, and a company can be one without the other. Defaults to Standard, never to the cheaper regime: an unset field must not silently reduce someone's tax. The lump-sum (turnover) regime is deliberately not an option — it is available only to businesses that do NOT keep accounting books, which a business running this software does.

Company.label: Number Sales Invoices per Company (ເລກໃບເກັບເງິນແຍກຕາມບໍລິສັດ)
Company.description: Give this company its own invoice sequence, so its numbers are contiguous rather than interleaved with other companies on this site. TURNING THIS ON STARTS A NEW SEQUENCE AT 1 — existing invoices keep their numbers, so there is one deliberate break. Discuss with your accountant first.
Company._why: Frappe keeps ONE counter per naming-series prefix per SITE — measured: tabSeries has a single row 'ACC-SINV-2026-' with no company in the key. Two companies on one site therefore interleave, and neither has a gapless sequence of its own, which is hard to explain to an auditor under any rule. Off by default because switching a live company's numbering is a decision, not a default, and because Q9 in BERP-LAO-QUESTIONS-001 may yet make the whole question moot.

Customer Tax ID (ເລກປະຈຳຕົວລູກຄ້າ)
Sales Invoice._why: Fetched from the Customer but editable: a Lao invoice must carry the TIN as it stood when the invoice was issued, not as the customer record reads today.

Sales Invoice.label: Invoice Type (ປະເພດໃບເກັບເງິນ)
Sales Invoice._why: Drives the VAT rules and the VAT return's split. 'Simplified' is treated as standard-rated throughout — it is a documentation concession, not a rate.
